_comment: Interactive open_action_menu skills that PROMPT at COMPUTE with no auto-pick, so they only ever record reason:'timeout' (a 12s guard each). Skipping them keeps capture + check fast (~1 min vs ~5.5 min) and consistent; their fingerprint becomes reason:'skipped' instead. This loses no real compute signal — they can't be meaningfully compute-fingerprinted without per-skill menu picks. Auto-loaded by both capture and check. To exercise one for real, pass its menu choices via the collector's picks option, or remove it here. Regenerate the list from the golden: names where reason=='timeout'. Disable entirely with --no-skip.
_comment_skipSimulate: Skills whose RESOLVE waits on a human in the simulate harness (it runs no SimMode, so nothing answers the gate): Provoke's target roll is an interactive contest_check panel (always times out); Soul Steal's roll_loot_table opens a loot panel only on some rolls, so it FLIPS between ok and timeout run to run (2026-09-27: Rogue ok, Keren/Zarg timeout). Applied in --mode simulate ONLY — compute still fingerprints them. Their real-battle behaviour is covered by the sim scenarios (tools/fvtt-playwright/scripts/scenario-*.mjs), where SimMode answers the gates.
